# Example data

The two CSV files in this directory are deterministic synthetic examples created only to demonstrate the canonical input structure expected by MIMSTEM.

- `mims_example_tem.csv`: one time-to-event mediator; columns include `A`, `t_out`, `d_out`, `t_med`, `d_med`, `age`, and `sex`.
- `mims_example_s2tem.csv`: two sequential time-to-event mediators; columns include `A`, `t_out`, `d_out`, `t_med1`, `d_med1`, `t_med2`, `d_med2`, `age`, and `sex`.

These files are not empirical dissertation data and should not be used for scientific inference.
